edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.bedaŭr: User adopted 惜ᴮ: share 惜 with semantically close domaĝ; reduce strokes and eliminate the dedicated character 憾.
rationale.raŭk: User adopted 哑ᴿ: 哑 has a hoarse-voice sense; distinguish mut=哑 and retain the hoarseness annotation.
rationale.buf: User adopted 蟆 as representative character of 蛤蟆; preserve the toad annotation and existing root.
rationale.lofi: User adopted 蟆鱼 in parallel with buf; retain 鱼 and the anglerfish annotation.
rationale.aŭtomat: User adopted 自动: 自 explicitly contributes autonomous operation; existing characters are shared.
rationale.au^tomaci: User adopted 自动ᴬᶜ in the same semantic family, keeping its reviewed identity.
